# Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

We want participation in this project to be a respectful and harassment-free
experience for everyone, regardless of age, background, experience level,
nationality, gender identity, or any other personal characteristic.

## Expected Behavior

- Be respectful and constructive in issues, pull requests, and discussions.
- Give and accept feedback graciously.
- Assume good intent and focus on what is best for the project.
- Welcome newcomers and help them get started.

## Unacceptable Behavior

- Harassment, insults, or personal attacks.
- Discriminatory language or imagery.
- Publishing others' private information without permission.
- Spam, trolling, or deliberately disruptive behavior.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may edit, remove, or reject comments, commits, issues, and pull
requests that do not follow this Code of Conduct, and may temporarily or
permanently ban contributors for behavior they consider harmful.

Report violations by emailing <your-email@example.com>. All reports are
reviewed and handled confidentially.
